participation.context: Wrote the three notes and stayed in the room.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: no tally is set down on a day that is not played

story.body: You stayed at the desk. You wrote that The Shrew at two was not yours, that the refusal stays, and that the gown is unpaid. You added no tally.

relations.note: no tally is set down on a day that is not played

title: Stayed at the lodging while The Shrew was played
